outline: This course is an introductory course seeking to familiarize students with the basic materials of construction, how they are made and used, and how they can be used to further architectural design ideas.
schedule:
Class Schedule:
1.   Introduction to Courses
2.   Steel Frame Construction
3.   Steel Frame Construction
4.   Light Gauge Steel Construction
5.   Light Gauge Steel Construction
6.   Wood
7.   Wood
8.   Review for Midterm Exam
9.   Midterm Exam
10. Heavy Timber Frame Construction
11. Heavy Timber Frame Construction
12. Light Wood Frame Construction
13. Light Wood Frame Construction
14. Exterior Finishes
15. Interior Finishes
16. Roofing and Extra Stairs
17. Review for Final Exam
18. Final Exam
assessment:
1. Attendance - 10%
2. Assigned Readings/Assignments - 30%
3. Exams/Quizzes - 50%
4. Semester Project - 10%

P.S.: Student who misses more than three classes with no acceptable reason will receive "F" as the student's final grade.
